test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 24 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series to continue the pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c3aa0b9a966803e251e9ee2c924113c164b1190328f9410757293fe327de1b7.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The center element is replaced by new element.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4df3a01ecfe1d8411f3a6a654d172c6de5b109e9a663962681e7a57f7811325a.png] 

2) Second box series → 

The 2nd column elements shift anticlockwise in the downward direction subsequently.

The 1st column elements shift to the 3rd column diagonally.

The 3rd column elements shift to the 1st column at the same position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/060e22de1986519d8c1bdcfb8173955c2a45cf58fb5bc8b8e6ef5027d0295f50.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36e991e2a1d14d7d758112f73cb9d92cec944d6c15c857ebfbdc09a51ad9e491.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
